items.original_title: Run agent-driven Amazon SageMaker HyperPod operations with InstantStart
items.title: Run agent-driven Amazon SageMaker HyperPod operations with InstantStart
items.summary: HyperPod InstantStart is an open source control plane that composes Amazon EKS orchestration with the managed capabilities of Amazon SageMaker HyperPod. It drives the same guarded operations through both a web interface and an AI agent, turning cluster bootstrap, capacity, training, inference, and storage into dependable, agent-driven infrastructure.

items.original_title: Set up OpenAI ChatGPT Codex with LiteLLM on Amazon ECS and Amazon Bedrock
items.title: Set up OpenAI ChatGPT Codex with LiteLLM on Amazon ECS and Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Deploy a customer-operated LiteLLM gateway on Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate, connect it to an OpenAI model on Amazon Bedrock, and configure Codex to route requests through the gateway's Responses API with scoped identities, budgets, rate limits, and telemetry. We also compare direct IAM Identity Center access and a managed Portkey deployment.

items.original_title: Accessing OpenAI models on Amazon Bedrock from Australia with global cross-Region inference
items.title: Accessing OpenAI models on Amazon Bedrock from Australia with global cross-Region inference
items.summary: Australian teams can now access OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna models on Amazon Bedrock with global cross-Region inference from the Asia Pacific (Sydney) and Asia Pacific (Melbourne) Regions. This post shows how to invoke the models, use prompt caching, set up Codex with OpenID Connect authentication, and monitor usage with Amazon CloudWatch.

items.original_title: Deploy a multimodal WhatsApp ordering assistant with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.title: Deploy a multimodal WhatsApp ordering assistant with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Learn how to deploy a multimodal WhatsApp ordering assistant that takes customer orders through text, voice notes, and real-time voice calls on a single business number, built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with Amazon Nova 2. The channel and ordering layers stay separate, and one shared memory recognizes each customer across all three channels.
